reason: This changes the planner/core plan-cache cloning path, not just a local helper. `CloneForPlanCache` controls how cached physical plans are copied for reuse, so a generation/parity mistake can create broad shared-state or stale-state correctness bugs across prepared-plan-cache execution. Even if the intent is codegen/mechanical, the blast radius is central enough in planner/runtime behavior to justify a deeper Blocker/High-focused review.
